sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, face Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain leaders and will be favored against Alsager, who sit bottom with just 4 points and have won only once all season. This is Sandbach's only fixture in the coming week.
divisionWide: Second-place Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town on Saturday, looking to close the gap on leaders Sandbach after their own recent loss. Third-placed AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in what shapes as a competitive encounter between top-half sides. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth and in good recent form, host Wednesfield Community at home on Saturday before facing Brereton Social away on Wednesday evening. Bilston Town, fifth and on a winning streak, travel to Foley Meir on Saturday. Barnton welcome Shawbury United in a mid-table clash; Shawbury have struggled dramatically with five consecutive losses. Market Drayton Town host New Mills on Saturday; New Mills themselves are inconsistent but picked up a recent win. Eccleshall play at home against AFC Bridgnorth. Crewe entertain Allscott Heath on Saturday in a lower-half fixture. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to face Telford Town—both struggling sides near the bottom. Brereton Social host Widnes Town on Saturday; Widnes remain pointless in the division. The midweek fixture sees Brereton Social travel to face Wednesfield Community on Wednesday 7 October.
